Subject: SIG follow-up — Audit logging: May export, retention, and playback access

Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intake on the SIG questionnaire. One of the remaining asks on our side: we need an export of audit/event logs for our tenant (tenant id: fintera-prod) covering May 1–31, 2027 to validate retention and to ingest into our SIEM. Specifically: 

- A CSV extract with fields: timestamp, event_type, user_id (or redacted), source_ip, request_id, model, request_size, response_tokens.
- Confirmation of default retention (RPO) for audit events and whether we can request ad-hoc snapshots older than default retention (we saw 90d documented, but SIG requires ability to obtain up to 12 months for evidence).
- Mechanism for secure delivery and whether Redwood can provide a short-lived playback/API or an S3 pre-signed export.
- A short attestation (text) that exported events exclude PII and what redaction rules were applied.

Also: does Redwood support tenant-scoped live playback (for reprocessing) or just point-in-time exports? We are flagging this as a high-priority SIG item and would like ETA for a sample row and full export.

Thanks — if easier to sync, we can take a 20m call.

—Audrey
Audrey Lin
Security Engineer, Fintera
security@fintera.com


From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — Audit logging: May export, retention, and playback access

Hi Audrey — thanks for the clear list. We can support both: (A) tenant-scoped point-in-time CSV exports, and (B) short-lived playback streams for limited reprocessing use cases (subject to export limits & extra controls). High-level answers up front:

- Default retention: 90 days for full raw event stream on Hosted API tier.
- Extended snapshot exports: Available up to 13 months post-event on enterprise contracts (Fintera's Dedicated/Private add-on covers this).
- Delivery mechanisms: S3 pre-signed URL (preferred), SFTP, or scoped API export. We typically deliver CSV gzipped with checksum.
- Redaction/PII: by default we redact explicit PII fields (payment numbers, full SSNs, plaintext credentials). We will provide an attestation of the redaction rules applied to this export.

Next steps I propose:
1) We’ll deliver a 10–20 row sample within 48 business hours so your team can confirm fields/format.
2) After you confirm, we’ll schedule a full export (ETD 2–10 business days depending on range/size).
3) If you need a playback API instead of a bulk export, we can discuss the scope and additional controls (signed request, time-limited tokens).

Couple quick clarifying Qs: do you want raw event_level rows or aggregated/normalized rows for SIEM ingestion? Also confirm whether Fintera requires a signed attestation on Redwood letterhead or an internal attestation text is sufficient.

Looping in Kimberly and Vivek to prepare sample and ETA.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

- Schema: timestamp (ISO8601), event_type, user_id (hashed/redacted), source_ip (last-octet masked), request_id, model, request_size, response_tokens.
- Remove all PII per standard redaction rules; include a short note describing the rules applied.
- Provide expected row count and compressed file size estimate and whether KV-cache/internal ephemeral traces are excluded.
- Delivery preference: generate a gzipped CSV in our secure-export S3 bucket and give a pre-signed URL valid 7 days. Include MD5 checksum and an export manifest.

Customer has this on an active SIG review; target to get sample within 48 business hours and full export within 3 business days if size < 200k rows, otherwise 7–10 business days.

Thanks — Marissa
